summary: The bill nullifies the March 27, 2025 executive order that excludes certain federal employees from labor-management relations programs, bars use of federal funds to implement it, and keeps all collective bargaining agreements in effect as of March 26, 2025, fully valid through their stated terms.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly nullifies an executive order that would exclude certain federal agencies from federal labor-management relations programs, thereby restoring and protecting collective bargaining rights for federal employees. It also ensures existing collective bargaining agreements remain in effect. This is the central purpose of the bill.
